operations.content: Hermes MCP server for repo code-map is named trailcode (config mcp_servers.trailcode, script scripts/trailcode-mcp.cmd), never graft; user gets confused otherwise. It runs global @nanonets/graft@0.15.0 from F:/CD/Opencode (which holds the graft/ index). Do NOT upgrade: 0.25.x serves deferred tools this client reads as 0 tools. Wrapper needed because the server resolves its repo from cwd and Hermes home has no index.
